verdict.rationale: Adyen provides extensive documented REST/Checkout APIs, webhooks, idempotency keys, testing tools, and even an official MCP server for LLM-driven natural language access, indicating strong AI-native accessibility. Community notes cite integration complexity/XML legacy for some flows, but core API is well documented and machine-consumable (llms.txt, docs.md endpoints present, though no discoverable OpenAPI spec at standard paths).
